messages:
sophia: Postmortem follow-up: we need one canonical external summary and a clear rule for who can request a redacted RCA. Also tagging this as a recurring eviction-pattern incident.

ben: +1. I can own the remediation ticket (INF-5288). ETA for code fix + canary: ~2 weeks. Short-term: we bumped cache TTL and added burst nodes.

irina: I'll draft the status page copy. Please send a one-line non-technical cause and the mitigation bullets.

infra-bot: Created COMMS-1300 assigned to irina (status-page draft).

ben: One-line cause: an eviction interaction under extreme concurrency increased latency for a subset of requests. Mitigations: accelerated autoscaling, adjusted cache TTL, temporary rollback of packing heuristic.

legal: Quick note: confirm "No customer data was exposed" with the forensics team before publishing. Use phrase "redacted root cause analysis" for enterprise requests.

customer-success: We'll prepare targeted outreach for customers with SLAs and offer a 1:1 where requested. Please include a contact link in the summary.

irina: Draft (first pass): 
"On March 22 we observed elevated latency for a subset of inference requests during a high-concurrency event. We applied short-term mitigations to restore service and are implementing a long-term fix. No customer data was exposed. Enterprise customers can request a redacted root cause analysis and remediation timeline via support."

sophia: Nice draft. Legal: can you confirm the PII statement within 24h?

legal: Will confirm after final forensic sign-off.

sophia: Action items (to copy to tracker):
- irina: Finalize status copy + 2-line FAQ and submit to legal (due: 2026-03-29) [owner: irina]
- ben: INF-5288 remediation work and weekly progress updates (due: 2026-04-09) [owner: ben]
- customer-success: Assemble SLA customer list + outreach draft (due: 2026-03-31) [owner: customer-success]
- sophia: Decide RCA-sharing threshold policy and update incident policy doc (due: 2026-04-02) [owner: sophia]

infra-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-30 to check COMMS-1300 status.

ben: I'll update INF-5288 this afternoon with a short timeline and the canary plan.

sophia: Thanks everyone, please update this thread when tasks are complete so I can close the loop.
